outcome: On macOS, Linux, and Windows, the single geminus binary lets users interact directly with claude or hermes over a PTY using `geminus run`, resume the same conversation with `geminus run --resume <id>`, and inspect local records with `geminus ls` / `geminus log`. No daemon, database, or network is required.
non_goals: Daemon, backend, relay, or HTTP server (the domain of geminised)
Live attach or multiplexing from another terminal
Inter-agent communication, group fan-out, or push notifications
Summarizing and reinjecting conversation history (a possible --replay feature for v0.2)
GUI / TUI dashboards or release pipelines (such as goreleaser)
constraints: Go 1.23 or later; module path: github.com/hauntedfail/geminus
Must build for darwin/linux/windows × amd64/arm64 with CGO_ENABLED=0
No network, daemon, or database at runtime. Store state only in files under GEMINUS_HOME.
The only external dependencies are github.com/aymanbagabas/go-pty and golang.org/x/term.
Do not read or store agent credentials. Let the child process inherit the environment unchanged.
Transparent relay: do not interpret or reconstruct agent output (except for capture in ask mode).
Do not change the state of other existing projects or agents.

tasks.title: Session store
tasks.context: Store geminus state in GEMINUS_HOME/sessions/<id>/: session.json for metadata, transcript.jsonl for appended events, and raw.log for raw bytes. Replace metadata atomically and only append events. Use 0700 for directories and 0600 for files.
tasks.expected_behavior: Support creating, loading, listing, and deleting sessions. List by most recent update, not creation order. Update metadata via a temporary file and rename so readers never see a partial update. Return an error without panicking on corrupt JSON. Record the current raw.log offset when appending an event.
acceptance: Create creates the <id> directory and session.json with permissions 0700 and 0600, respectively.
Load restores the saved contents exactly (round-trip match).
List returns sessions in descending updated_at order.
Delete removes the entire directory and returns an error if it does not exist.
Load returns an error for a corrupt session.json without panicking.
AppendEvent records the current length of raw.log as the offset.
seq increases monotonically across successive appends within the same process.
stop_conditions: A storage format change (session.json fields) is requested.
The file permission requirement changes from 0600.
completion_evidence: Corrupt session.json returned an error (no panic)

tasks.title: PTY proxy
tasks.context: Give the child process a real TTY and relay data in both directions between it and the user's terminal. go-pty handles Unix/Windows differences; the proxy handles raw mode, resizing, signals, and exit codes. Provide a replaceable terminal interface for testing.
tasks.expected_behavior: On a TTY, enter raw mode and always restore the terminal on exit. Relay stdin to the PTY and PTY output to stdout; tee output to the recording destination. On SIGWINCH, update the child's terminal size. Return the child's exit code unchanged. If stdin is not a TTY, skip raw mode and send EOT once at EOF.
acceptance: Writes reach the child, and child output reaches the caller (verified with an in-memory terminal).
A child exit code of 7 is returned as 7.
A resize request calls Resize on the terminal.
Non-TTY input does not enter raw mode.
The recording destination receives exactly the bytes relayed.
Compilation for Windows succeeds with GOOS=windows.
